fusions.name: Quarry at Bay
fusions.desc: A finishing thrust that deals 18 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 50% more damage for each one. It leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Past the Pack
fusions.desc: Thrusts through a narrow cone 3.5 tiles long that deals 4 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each enemy [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Fetch
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Holds Till You Come
fusions.desc: A bonded boarhound runs with you, striking enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.1 seconds. Anything it bites moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
